title: Nonparametric Kernel Regression for Coordinated Energy Storage Peak Shaving with Stacked Services
summary: Developing effective control strategies for behind-the-meter energy storage to coordinate peak shaving and stacked services is essential for reducing electricity costs and extending battery lifetime in commercial buildings. This work proposes an end-to-end, two-stage framework for coordinating peak shaving and energy arbitrage with a theoretical decomposition guarantee. In the first stage, a non-parametric kernel regression model constructs state-of-charge trajectory bounds from historical data that satisfy peak-shaving requirements.
